about.title: Privacy and disclaimer
about.dataBody: CarePill has no account or sign-in. Your medicines, dose records and conversations are stored only on this phone. We cannot access them.
about.aiBody: Answers come from the AI service you configure. Your questions and photos are sent to that provider and are subject to its privacy policy. API keys stay in your phone's secure storage and are not uploaded or exported unless you explicitly request it.
about.adviceTitle: Can you rely on everything AI says?
about.adviceBody:
No. AI answers are for reference. Follow your doctor's instructions.

• Information read from photos is a draft and must be checked before saving.
• Ask a doctor or pharmacist before changing a dose, switching medicines or stopping treatment.
• For chest pain, trouble breathing or a fall, seek urgent medical care or call your local emergency number.
about.remindersBody: Some phones restrict background apps, which can delay reminders. Follow Settings → Phone setup guide, then use Test reminder to check.
